title: readmd configuration
description: Settings for readmd, the terminal Markdown viewer. Lives in ~/.config/readmd/config.json (%APPDATA%\readmd\config.json on Windows) or a project-level .readmd.json. Every key is optional; command-line flags override these values.

$schema.description: Schema reference for editor validation; ignored by readmd.

theme.description: Default theme: dark, light, auto (follows the terminal background), a built-in name (nord, dracula, gruvbox-dark, solarized-dark, solarized-light, catppuccin-mocha, one-dark, tokyo-night, monokai) or a custom theme defined under "themes".

themeCycle.description: Theme names the [ key cycles through, in order. Default: every built-in and custom theme.

background.description: solid paints the theme background (overrides terminal transparency); terminal shows the terminal's own background through. Toggle live with ].

d2Path.description: Path to the d2 executable (default: d2 on PATH).

mermaidCliPath.description: Path to mmdc (mermaid-cli); renders mermaid without a headless Chromium download.

graphvizPath.description: Path to the Graphviz dot executable.

plantUmlPath.description: Path to the plantuml launcher (needs Java).

krokiUrl.description: Kroki server used for diagram kinds without a local tool (default https://kroki.io). Self-host for privacy: the diagram text is sent to this server.

krokiFallback.description: Use Kroki when a local diagram tool is missing. false = local tools only.

graphics.description: Inline image protocol. auto detects from the terminal; none shows diagram source / box art instead.

maxWidth.description: Maximum reading width in columns; content is centred when the terminal is wider. 0 = full width. Also the wrap width for --print.

lineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in code blocks (per-fence: nonums / showLineNumbers).

tabSize.description: Tab stop used when expanding tabs inside code blocks.

smartPunctuation.description: Typographic replacements: smart quotes, dashes and ellipses.

color.description: Colour depth. auto detects (and honours NO_COLOR / FORCE_COLOR); always colours even piped --print output.

hyperlinks.description: Emit OSC 8 hyperlinks so links are Ctrl/Cmd-clickable in supporting terminals.

confirmExternalLinks.description: Ask before opening an external link in the browser (Ctrl+click always skips the prompt).

ascii.description: Plain 7-bit ASCII instead of box-drawing characters and symbols (also --ascii / READMD_ASCII=1).

ambiguousWide.description: Treat East Asian Ambiguous characters as two cells wide, as CJK-locale terminals do.

network.description: Allow network access (remote images, Kroki, remote documents). false = offline (also --offline / READMD_OFFLINE=1).

rememberPosition.description: Remember the reading position, bookmarks and search history per file across sessions.

scrollbar.description: Show a scrollbar at the right edge.

watch.description: Live-reload when the file changes (W toggles at runtime; --no-watch disables).

themes.description: Custom colour themes, selectable by name via "theme", --theme or :theme. Unset colours come from "base" (a built-in theme) or the dark/light default.

keys.description: Key binding overrides: action name -> a chord or a list of chords. An override replaces every default binding of that action. Chords: single keys ("x", "?"), sequences ("gg", "]]"), modifiers ("ctrl+q", "alt+f", "shift+tab"), named keys (enter, esc, tab, space, up, down, left, right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, backspace, delete, f1-f12) or Vim-style ("<C-d>", "<S-Tab>").

dark.description: Whether this is a dark theme (chooses the dark or light default palette for unset colours). Defaults to the base theme's.

base.description: Built-in theme to inherit unset colours from: dark, light, nord, dracula, gruvbox-dark, solarized-dark, solarized-light, catppuccin-mocha, one-dark, tokyo-night, monokai.

codeTheme.description: TextMate theme for code blocks, e.g. dark-plus, light-plus, dracula, monokai, one-dark, solarized-dark, solarized-light, atom-one-dark, kimbie-dark, tomorrow-night-blue, quiet-light. Defaults to the base theme's.

muted.description: Secondary text: metadata, list gutters, status bar.

heading.description: Headings H4 and below (H1-H3 have their own colours).

code.description: Inline code and the plain-text fallback colour for code blocks.

quote.description: Blockquote text and bar (defaults to muted).

rule.description: Horizontal rules, table borders, panel borders.

backgroundElevated.description: Panels, overlays and the status bar.

codeBorder.description: Left gutter bar of code blocks.

searchBackground.description: Search-hit highlight (the active hit is derived from it).

selectionBackground.description: Selected rows in overlays and mark-mode selections (defaults to accent).
